title: Lost in the city
persona: You are a helpful Sydney local walking near Circular Quay. You give directions quickly, with landmarks, and you use Australian expressions.
briefTr: Opera Binası'nı arıyorsun ama kayboldun. Sonra Manly'ye feribotla gideceksin. Tarifi tekrar ederek kontrol et.
opening: You right there? You look a bit lost.

facts.question: How long was the walk to the Opera House?
facts.questionTr: Opera Binası'na yürüyüş ne kadar sürdü?

facts.question: Which stand did the replacement bus leave from?

goals.instruction: The visitor says they are lost and asks how to get to a place.
goals.hint: Yes, I'm lost. How do I get to the Opera House?
goals.hintTr: Evet, kayboldum. Opera Binası'na nasıl giderim?
goals.successReply: Easy — go straight on, past the ferry wharf, and it's on your right.

goals.instruction: The visitor repeats the directions to check.
goals.hint: So, straight on, past the wharf, and it's on the right?
goals.hintTr: Yani düz, iskeleyi geç, sağda mı?
goals.retryReply: Want me to say that again?

goals.instruction: The visitor asks how long it takes on foot.
goals.hint: How long does it take on foot?
goals.retryReply: Anything else you need to know?

goals.ask: Ferry tickets here! Where are you off to?
goals.instruction: A new character: a ferry ticket officer. The visitor asks when the next ferry to Manly is.
goals.hint: When is the next ferry to Manly?
goals.persona: You are a ferry ticket officer at Circular Quay in Sydney. You are brisk but helpful, and today some ferries are cancelled.

goals.ask: Sorry, the three-thirty to Manly is cancelled.
goals.instruction: The ferry is cancelled. The visitor asks for another way, such as a replacement bus.
goals.successReply: Yes — take the replacement bus from stand {stand}.
goals.retryReply: Do you want to know other ways to get there?

goals.instruction: The visitor asks where to get off.
goals.successReply: Get off at Manly Wharf — it's the last stop.

twists.instruction: The directions were too fast. The visitor asks to repeat slowly, asks one step at a time, or asks to show it on the map.

options.text: Sorry, could you say that more slowly?
options.reply: Sure. Straight on. Past the wharf. On your right.

options.text: One step at a time, please?
options.reply: First, go straight. Then, pass the wharf. It's on the right.

options.text: Could you show me on my map?
options.reply: Here — you're here, and it's just there.

twists.intro: Oh wait, there are roadworks on that path. You'll have to go around.
twists.instruction: The path is closed. The visitor asks for the new way, asks how long it adds, or asks if there's a bus.
twists.retryReply: It's always something in this city!

options.text: Which way should I go then?
options.reply: Go left at the corner, then follow the water.

options.text: How much longer will it take?

options.reply: You could, but walking is quicker.

twists.intro: The Opera House or the Opera Bar? Lots of tourists mix them up!
twists.instruction: The local is unsure which place. The visitor clarifies, describes it, or shows a photo.

options.text: The Opera House, the big white building.
options.reply: Ah, the big one! Straight on, you can't miss it.

options.text: Let me show you a photo.
options.reply: Oh, the Opera House. Straight on!
Right, the Opera House. Straight ahead.

twists.intro: The first replacement bus is already full, I'm afraid.
twists.instruction: The bus is full. The visitor asks when the next one is, asks about a taxi, or asks to wait.

options.text: Should I take a taxi instead?
options.reply: It's about forty dollars to Manly. Up to you.

options.text: Okay, I'll wait for the next bus.

twists.intro: Do you have an Opal card? Your ferry ticket might not work on the bus.
twists.instruction: The visitor's ticket might not be valid. The visitor asks if they need a new ticket, says they paid for the ferry, or asks where to buy one.

options.text: Do I need a new ticket?
options.reply: No, with a cancelled ferry the bus is free.

options.text: But I already paid for the ferry.
options.reply: Fair point — you can ride the bus for free.

options.text: Where can I buy a ticket?
options.reply: No need — replacement buses are free today.

twists.intro: Careful — that bus at stand A goes to Bondi, not Manly.
twists.instruction: The visitor nearly takes the wrong bus. The visitor thanks the officer, asks which bus is right, or asks where stand is.

options.reply: The one that says Manly Replacement.

options.text: Where exactly is the right stand?
options.reply: Turn around — it's the one with the yellow sign.

options.text: Oops, good thing you told me!
